items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1960-07-14
items.q: I wish I had met Jelly Rule but he had already left. ... And of course I had heard of him

ctx.x: How were you when you went to see Mrs. Asset?

I imagine I was about eight or nine years old. I couldn't have been much younger or older than that. And I didn't stay with her too long, about a year maybe a little better. And then I began practicing all these chords and listening to the sounds and getting pointers here and there from different piano players. Of course, I wish I had met Jelly Rule but he had already left. He was a little bit too far before me. And of course I had heard of him and heard of Steve Lewis. I knew, I had heard a lot of good piano…
Oh, about your grandfather, did he play by music or was he a faker or both?
